## Recipe checklist

<!-- Only for pull requests that add or change a file in recipes/. Delete this section otherwise. -->

- [ ] The recipe was created with `scripts/recipe.py new`, or by hand following docs/recipes.md

- [ ] Every setting in `defaults` has a link to the model card (or other primary source) it comes from
- [ ] `license_note` is accurate: it names the licence of each component and any restriction such as non-commercial use, with a link to where each licence is stated
- [ ] `min_memory_gb` (per variant, when there are variants) is a value I tested, or a conservative one and I have said so above
- [ ] Variants, if any, are the same model in different quantizations and share the recipe's settings
- [ ] Every file comes from the model authors or a well-known converter, and its name describes its content
- [ ] `recipes/index.json` was regenerated by the script, not edited by hand
